homePage.seoText: NKN Atelier is a design atelier in Hamburg where bespoke tailoring is built around your personality, precise fit and thoughtful construction. Here you can order custom garments, discover one-of-one pieces, explore author prints and commission upcycling projects. We work in Hamburg in person and also online: consultation, materials selection, measurements and fittings (or remote guidance) — a full cycle from idea to finished piece.

seo.description: Reconstruction of garments from your wardrobe: recutting, new silhouette and modern aesthetic. Sustainable fashion with an artistic approach.

upcycling.seoText: Upcycling at NKN Atelier (Hamburg) is not “repair” — it is an artistic transformation of garments from your wardrobe. We analyse fabric and construction, propose a new silhouette and function, and preserve what is valuable in the original piece. The result is a contemporary garment with a new story, made with professional finishing. Suitable for coats, blazers, dresses, shirts and more.

01.question: How does the process start?
01.answer: We begin with a consultation where you show me the garment and describe your vision. I analyze the piece, assess its potential, and suggest transformation options. Then we discuss the concept and agree on the direction.

02.question: How long does upcycling take?
02.answer: Typically 2-4 weeks, depending on the complexity. Simple reconstructions take less time, while complete transformations with new construction require more work. I will give you a timeline after our initial consultation.

03.question: Is it possible to fully change the garment?
03.answer: Yes. Upcycling can range from subtle updates to complete reconstruction. I can change the silhouette, add or remove elements, combine multiple pieces, or create something entirely new while respecting the original fabric and history.

04.question: Do you work with both women's and men's clothing?
04.answer: Yes, I work with all types of garments regardless of original gender categorization. What matters is the quality of the fabric, the construction potential, and your vision for transformation.

05.question: What if the fabric is damaged?
05.answer: Damaged areas can often be incorporated into the new design or removed during reconstruction. Sometimes imperfections become part of the story. I will assess the condition during consultation and suggest the best approach.

privacyPage.seoText: This page provides GDPR-based privacy information for contacting, consulting and bespoke tailoring services by Nataliia Khreshkova (NKN).
privacyPage.intro: Protecting your personal data is very important to me. I process your data confidentially and in accordance with the GDPR and this privacy notice.

general.title: 1. General information
general.content:
Personal data is any information relating to an identified or identifiable person (e.g., name, phone number, photos, body measurements, message contents).

This notice explains which data I process when you first contact me, during 1:1 style consultations, in-person visits, or bespoke tailoring.

dataProcessing.title: 3. Data processed and purposes
dataProcessing.content:
I process personal data solely within my professional activity as a fashion designer, style consultant and provider of bespoke tailoring.

a) Contact and scheduling
Collected when you contact me via Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, TikTok, Telegram or email.
Processed data:
• Name or username
• Phone number
• Email address
• Message contents
• Appointment details (place, time)
• Information about wishes, style questions, physical specifics
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual steps, contract performance)
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in efficient communication)

b) Personal 1:1 consultation – on-site or with me
Processed data:
• Body measurements (e.g., bust, waist, hips, arm length, back length)
• Necessary fit measurements using a tape measure
• Photos of clothing and silhouette (if voluntarily provided)
• Style preferences, materials, colors, wishes
• Figure specifics (e.g., posture, proportions, individual fit requirements)
Note:
Physical contact during measuring (placing a tape measure) serves purely technical purposes and is not data processing itself. Only the measurement results are processed.
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR

c) Bespoke tailoring and garment design
Processed data:
• Measurements and fit data
• Technical sketches
• Fabric and design selection
• Photos for fit analysis (if voluntarily provided)
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR

d) Payments
Processed data (depending on payment method):
• Name
• Bank details (IBAN)
• PayPal name/email
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR
Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR (tax retention obligations)

whatsapp.title: 4. WhatsApp Business communication
whatsapp.content:
I use WhatsApp Business.
Message contents are end-to-end encrypted.
However, WhatsApp may process metadata (time, sender, recipient, device type).
WhatsApp privacy policy:
https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/#privacy-policy
Legal bases:
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR
Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (customer inquiries)

telegram.title: 5. Telegram communication
telegram.content:
Telegram uses server-side encryption.
Secret chats are end-to-end encrypted.
Processed data:
• Username
• Metadata
• Message contents
Telegram privacy policy:
https://telegram.org/privacy
Legal basis:
Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR

disclosure.title: 6. Disclosure to third parties
disclosure.content:
I do not share personal data with third parties, except:
• when necessary for contract performance (e.g., tax advisor)
• when required by law (e.g., tax authorities)

No sharing with:
• advertising companies
• social media platforms
• tracking services
• analytics companies

retention.title: 7. Retention period
retention.content:
I store personal data:
• as long as necessary for consultation or bespoke tailoring
• and according to legal retention periods (6–10 years)
